Northern Adelaide Local Health Network - Lyell McEwin Hospital - ELIZABETH VALE SA 5112

Salary: $66,442 - $69,504 p.a. - ASO2

Ongoing Full-Time 

About the Role:

Lyell McEwin Hospital is one of South Australia's busiest metropolitan hospitals, and the people who keep it running behind the scenes are just as important as those at the bedside. If you're an organised, people-focused administrator who takes pride in delivering accurate, timely support in a healthcare environment, this ongoing full-time opportunity within the Northern Adelaide Local Health Network (NALHN) is worth your attention.

Working across multiple services, you'll play a key role in maintaining continuity, efficiency and high-quality service delivery across the division.

What You'll Be Doing

Based at Lyell McEwin Health Service in Adelaide's northern suburbs, you'll provide essential administrative support that directly enables clinical teams to focus on patient care. Your day-to-day will include:

Managing correspondence, records, and document workflows in line with SA Health policies and privacy requirements

Coordinating scheduling, appointments, and meeting logistics for the unit

Responding to internal and external enquiries with accuracy and professionalism

Supporting data entry, reporting, and administrative processes using health information systems

What You'll Bring

Demonstrated experience in an administrative or customer-facing support role

Strong written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail

Ability to prioritise competing tasks and manage time effectively in a busy environment

Confidence using Microsoft Office and the ability to learn SA Health's clinical and administrative systems

A professional, respectful approach when engaging with patients, families, and clinical staff

Understanding of, or willingness to learn, confidentiality obligations in a public health setting

About You:

You will be joining a dynamic and expanding Local Health Network that is committed to delivering contemporary, innovative and high-quality health services within modern facilities.

This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of a passionate, highly driven and progressive team-where your skills, flexibility and positive attitude will make a genuine difference. We encourage you to apply and take the next step in your administrative career with us.

About Adelaide:

About Us:

The Northern Adelaide Local Health Network (NALHN) is a leading provider of public healthcare services in South Australia, and one of the largest employers in northern Adelaide. 

NALHN serves over 400,000 people in northern Adelaide with a comprehensive range of high-quality healthcare services, including emergency, surgical, obstetric, neonatal, paediatric, oncology, geriatric, palliative care and rehabilitation, and mental health care, as well as primary health care services with a focus on community health promotion and chronic disease management.

With a commitment for ongoing upgrades to our facilities and the introduction of new services, our priority is delivering exceptional health and wellbeing services that enhance the quality of life for our community.

With over 7,000 employees, NALHN emphasises quality care and a supportive work environment guided by respect, integrity, and accountability. Our core values foster excellence, innovation, and equitable health outcomes. 

At NALHN Everyone Has a Story, Everyone Matters, Everyone Contributes and Everyone Grows. 

Our Local Health Network Sites and Services:

NALHN provides a range of hospital (inpatient), outpatient, community and home-based services across multiple sites in Adelaide's north and north-eastern suburbs, including Aboriginal health, mental health, and GP services.

Lyell McEwin Hospital - the major hospital in northern Adelaide for emergency care, complex and multi-day surgery, medicine, obstetric, paediatrics and outpatient services.

Modbury Hospital - a general hospital with emergency care, elective surgery, medicine, outpatient and sub-acute services, rehabilitation, geriatric and palliative care.

Mental Health Services - adult and older persons mental health services and statewide forensic mental health services, across hospital and community settings.

Watto Purrunna Aboriginal Primary Health Care Services - provides culturally responsive primary healthcare services for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people in-hospital and across four community sites.

Primary Health Care Services - including GP Plus sites at Elizabeth, Modbury and Gilles Plains.

Benefits of working at NALHN:

From salary packaging to flexible working arrangements, a large range of opportunities for movement and career progression, you'll find there are lots of benefits of working with Northern Adelaide Local Health Network.

Salary packaging is an option for saving money by paying for some of your everyday expenses from your salary before it is taxed.

Relocation assistance may be available for successful applicants from interstate or overseas.

NALHN supports and fosters a culture in which employees feel they belong and feel safe at work. The culture aims to encourage all people to use their talents and to be valued and rewarded for their contributions.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if you have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working including part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check.

Check(s)

National Police Check (National Police Certificate) for vulnerable person-related employment screening - apply to any of the accredited bodies approved to offer a service direct to the public. Accreditation is provided by the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission. See our National Police Certificate accredited bodies page for links to lodge screening requests.

Immunisation Risk for this position is - Category B (indirect contact with blood or body substances)

result.description: RAM XPRESS PTY LTD  The purpose of the Retail Manager position at RAM XPRESS PTY LTD is to manage and oversee the daily operations of the company’s retail fuel outlet, convenience store, and food service operations. The role is responsible for ensuring smooth store performance, effective staff supervision, strong customer service, appropriate stock control, supplier coordination, sales growth, and compliance with workplace health, safety, and regulatory requirements.     The Retail Manager will be responsible for planning, organising, directing, and controlling the day-to-day operations of RAM XPRESS PTY LTD’s retail business. The role involves managing sales, inventory, purchasing, pricing, staff performance, customer service, budgets, supplier relationships, and store presentation. The Retail Manager will ensure that the business operates efficiently, maintains high service standards, meets customer expectations, and supports the company’s ongoing growth and profitability.      DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES    •    Developing and implementing purchasing strategies and marketing plans, while setting appropriate pricing for products and services.   •    Planning and organising the product range, including deciding stock levels and maintaining service quality standards.   •    Coordinating with suppliers and vendors to ensure timely delivery and quality of goods.   •    Monitoring inventory, performing regular stock checks, and maintaining accurate records of stock and financial transactions.   •    Preparing budgets, managing expenses, and ensuring cost-effective operations.   •    Promoting and advertising products and services to attract customers and increase sales.   •    Selling goods and services while assisting customers and providing guidance on product usage.   •    Handling customer feedback and resolving complaints to enhance customer satisfaction.   •    Recruiting, training, and supervising staff to ensure efficient performance and productivity.   •     Ensuring all activities comply with occupational health, safety, and regulatory requirements.      QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS    •    AQF associate degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma (ANZSCO Skill Level 2) in Business, Retail Management, or a related field   •    Minimum 1–2 years of relevant experience in retail or customer service management   •    Strong leadership and team management skills   •    Good communication and customer service abilities   •    Knowledge of inventory control, sales processes, and basic financial management      WORKING HOURS    Full-time position, 38 hours per week.      BENEFITS    •    Competitive salary with incentives   •    Training and career growth opportunities   •    Employee discounts   •    Supportive work environment   •    Safe and secure workplace  About Company    At RAM XPRESS Pty Ltd, we are dedicated to providing a convenient, reliable, and customer-focused experience for both local residents and travellers passing through Traralgon. Operating in the retail fuel, convenience retail, and food service sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of everyday essentials and services from one easily accessible location. Our site combines a modern retail fuel outlet, a well-stocked convenience store, and a hot food offering, enabling customers to refuel, shop, and enjoy fresh food all in one place. We take pride in delivering quality products, friendly service, and a welcoming environment that meets the needs of our diverse customer base. Since commencing operations, RAM XPRESS has remained committed to serving the Gippsland community through a seamless blend of fuel, retail, and food services. Our focus is on convenience, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, ensuring that every visit is a positive experience. At RAM XPRESS, we strive to be a trusted destination for everyday needs by continually delivering dependable service, quality offerings, and value to our customers.
